definitions.record: One per mention index of a Narrator node candidate. A Narrator candidate without a mention index is counted and left out. A mention that normalises to nothing is listed with matched = null and left out of the summary.
definitions.name: The mention string of system_proposed.jsonl at that index.
definitions.quotation: The first evidence quotation of the candidate.
definitions.flagged: value_not_in_quote is among the candidate's reason codes.
definitions.matched: The scorer's M2 alignment pairs the mention with a reference mention.
definitions.latin_script: The name has at least one letter and no letter in U+0621-U+064A or U+066E-U+06D3.
definitions.name_in_text_normalised: scorer.normalise(name) is a non-empty substring of scorer.normalise(hadith text); character level, not token level.
definitions.name_in_text_verbatim: The name is a substring of the hadith text as stored, code point for code point.
definitions.prophet_as_narrator: The normalised name contains one of رسول الله, النبي, or the name contains one of rasul allah, prophet, messenger in any letter case.
definitions.kinship_quote: The tokens of the normalised quotation, after dropping quote_function_tokens, are exactly one token and it is one of kinship_tokens.
definitions.case_ending_only: With case_forms folded (also with an attached و or ف) the tokens of the normalised name are a contiguous run of the tokens of the normalised quotation, and without the folding they are not. Vowel marks are removed on both sides by the normalisation.
definitions.class: Flagged mentions only; the first that applies: latin_transliteration (latin_script), kinship_resolved (kinship_quote), case_ending_only, other_in_text (name_in_text_normalised), other_not_in_text.
